output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, John Madsen is Goldman Sachs’ firmwide/global Chief Technology Officer and Head of Core Engineering. Goldman Sachs also appointed Dinesh Keswani as Chief Technology Officer of the distinct Core Engineering division in September 2026; the company’s official leadership page identifies Marco Argenti as Chief Information Officer, not CTO.
caveats: Goldman Sachs uses CTO titles at more than one organizational level: Madsen is the firmwide/global CTO, while Keswani’s official title is CTO of The Core Engineering. The company’s public leadership page does not list a separate firmwide CTO entry, so the distinction depends on the current executive profile and the September 2026 appointment announcement.
